findings.issue: The Testcontainers singleton pattern example still shows `.withReuse(true)` in the code block: `new MongoDBContainer("mongo:8.0").withReuse(true)`. The note immediately below it says 'Prefer a static singleton base class pattern instead' — but the example code contradicts the note. An auditor following the example will accept `.withReuse(true)` usage in reviewed code even though it silently fails in CI without `~/.testcontainers.properties`. The note and the example send opposite messages.
findings.fix: Remove `.withReuse(true)` from the example code block so it reads `new MongoDBContainer("mongo:8.0")`. The note about the CI limitation is correct and should remain, but the example must not show the pattern being warned against.

findings.issue: Section 5 (Delete account) describes the post-confirm flow as 'clear authStore.user, navigate to /auth/login' without the rationale comment present in Section 4. Section 4 explicitly documents WHY clearing before navigating is necessary ('prevents the auth middleware from triggering an extra GET /api/auth/me call'). Section 5 has the same requirement — navigate happens while session is already invalidated — but omits the rationale, making it likely an implementer treats the order as arbitrary and may inadvertently reverse it.
findings.fix: Add the same rationale to Section 5: 'clear authStore.user to null, then navigate to /auth/login (same rationale as Section 4 — prevents auth middleware from re-fetching /api/auth/me after session is gone)'.

findings.issue: Task 13 step 10 instructs writing findings to `work/02-auth/logs/working/task-13/security-auditor-1.json` but no step in 'What to do' creates the output directory. If the directory is absent, the write fails. Task 15 has an explicit `mkdir -p` step; Task 14 has the mkdir note buried in Details; Task 13 has neither.
findings.fix: Add as the first bullet in step 10 (or as a standalone step before step 10): 'Ensure output directory exists: `mkdir -p work/02-auth/logs/working/task-13/`'

findings.issue: `mkdir -p work/02-auth/logs/working/task-14/` instruction is at the bottom of the Details section, after all substantive audit steps. Task 15 correctly places its mkdir as the first pre-flight check in step 1. An auditor who writes the findings file before reaching the Details section may encounter a write failure.
findings.fix: Move `mkdir -p work/02-auth/logs/working/task-14/` from the Details section to step 1 of 'What to do' (as the very first action, before 'Discover all test files').
